Early-stage concepts · Public overview

01 / 04

The opportunity

Energy and water are connected at the point of use.

Coastal and island regions often plan for power and water as separate infrastructure problems. Our working concepts harness geothermal heat to support both pathways in a single regional system.

See the two technology pathways →

The challenge

Resilience needs steady inputs.

Demand for dependable clean energy and freshwater continues to shape infrastructure decisions, especially in water-stressed coastal and island settings.

01

Clean power

Grid and industrial users need reliable energy with a smaller dependence on combustion fuels.

02

Freshwater access

Desalination can help coastal communities, but the energy source and operating context matter.

03

Local fit

Geothermal resources vary by region, so a credible deployment path must start with site-specific validation.

Proposed technology

A heat-transfer concept with two outputs.

Heat-retaining spheres move through specialized piping, carrying thermal energy from a geothermal environment toward an energy or water application.

↯

Electricity generation

Transferred heat would support a steam geothermal generation pathway, subject to materials, control, and site validation.

≈

Thermal desalination

Thermal energy would support a water-treatment (Distilled) pathway that converts seawater into freshwater, subject to water-quality and permitting requirements.

+

Industrial heat

This dual system will process geothermal heat, with the potential to support commercial and residential infrastructure at scale.

Two technology pathways

Related ideas, distinct deployment assumptions.

The source materials describe two systems. They may be complementary, but the public overview keeps them separate until their technical relationship is confirmed.

Pathway 01Volcanic setting

Volcanic geothermal system

A concept for transferring heat from volcanic or lava environments using heat-retaining spheres and specialized piping.

  • Heat capture through a moving sphere and piping concept
  • Potential electricity and thermal desalination outputs
  • Requires site, material, safety, and environmental validation
Concept stage↗
Pathway 02Conventional geothermal

Multimode geothermal plant

An enclosed-loop underground geothermal concept intended to operate in geothermal regions without depending directly on active volcanic conditions.

  • Underground closed-loop operating premise
  • Potential fit for conventional geothermal regions
  • Engineering and commercial status requires confirmation
Concept stage↗
